title: PacketcraftR scan output payload v1
description: Success payload contract for the scan command. The stable envelope is validated separately.

rttSummary.description: Confirmed scan attempts partition into received replies, lost (no reply with qualified local coverage), and unavailable (unknown, incomplete, or local operational failure). Lost does not assert a remote cause. Pending no-reply measurements require observation_quality before final inference.

scanAdaptive.description: The effective adaptive scheduling configuration, published verbatim.

scanCondition.description: A scheduling condition inferred from observations; loss and filtering remain alternative explanations.

reverse_dns_stats.description: Packet statistics of the reverse-DNS lookups, which socket statistics cannot hold; absent when no lookup ran.

hosts.description: One record per selected target, in selection order.

reverse_dns_stats.description: Packet statistics of the reverse-DNS lookups, which socket statistics cannot hold; absent when no lookup ran.

probes.description: The probes each host received, in order, after any neighbor request.

neighbor.description: Whether ARP or NDP ran before the probes.

excluded_endpoints.description: Distinct expanded discovery endpoints --exclude-ports removed before planning; the plan's own excluded_endpoints covers the scan stage.

unresponsive.description: What the scan stage did with hosts that did not answer discovery.

scanHost.description: What discovery observed for one selected target, and whether the scan probed it. no_response is uncertainty, never absence.

probes.description: The discovery probes sent to this host, in sequence order.

scanHostId.description: A scoped host the scheduler names in conditions or as incomplete.

entry.description: fresh: a reply to this request; cached: an entry left by an earlier reply.

interface.description: The interface the host's route selected, where any reply was observed. Possible proxies share a link address on one interface.

observed_at.description: When the evidence was captured; absent for a reply whose capture carried no wall-clock time.

next_hop.description: The gateway a routed target is reached through, which is sent no request. Its link address appears only when already cached and is never the target's identity.

basis.description: possible_proxy flags a link address that also answered for another address of the same family, as a target or a next hop; it asserts no cause.

observed_at.description: When the evidence was captured; absent for a reply whose capture carried no wall-clock time.

scanInference.description: A scan-dependent conclusion drawn from the endpoint's attempts, which remain published beside it. Each attempt sequence appears in exactly one list.

state.description: Absent when every attempt was an operational failure. unfiltered is an ACK-scan conclusion: packets reach the port, which says nothing about a listening service.

scanIpProtocolSelection.description: The IP protocol numbers a scan of the listed targets would probe on every target, after exclusions.

scanPlan.description: How the scan was planned: its method, its discovery stage, and the versioned data sets it drew on. tcp_scan names the effective TCP segment for raw scans with TCP scan endpoints.

reason.description: Why automatic selection chose this method; absent for explicit methods.

timing.description: The timing preset that composed rate, timeout, attempts, and the in-flight bound; absent when those flags were used directly.

shuffle_seed.description: The seed the endpoint order was shuffled from; absent for the selected order.

scanPortHint.description: The catalog's conventional name for this transport and port; a hint, never service identification.

scanPortSelection.description: The port endpoints a scan of the listed targets would probe on every target, after exclusions.

scanQualification.description: Final source quality for existing pending no-reply measurements in this stage and inclusive sparse sequence interval. Final unknown/incomplete coverage and positive responses are unchanged.

hosts.description: One record per selected target, in selection order.

scanReverseDns.description: A PTR lookup through the DNS workflow; names are observations, not authenticated identity.

names_truncated.description: Present when the scan's evidence byte limit, which bounds the names kept across every lookup, dropped later names of this answer.

scanScheduling.description: How one operation scheduled its probes. mode is fixed or adaptive; observed_peak_window is the largest count of probes pending at once the operation actually held, not a throughput rate; ceilings are resource bounds, not achieved concurrency.

oneOf.description: One per target from either scan method, after the last probe and endpoint records and before complete.

scanTraceHostRecord.description: One scanned host's trace. not_traced hosts carry a reason and no probes; reused hops are separate from the freshly probed ones.

scanTraceReusedHop.description: A hop another host's trace observed in this operation, claimed for this host. It is a sourced claim, not an observation for this host.

probes.description: The source trace's probe sequences that observed the hop.

scanTraceSelection.description: The probe a host was traced with and what it rests on.

observation.description: The scan probe the selection rests on.

scanTraceroute.description: The trace stage requested by --traceroute: one record per scanned host, in host order.

scanTraceroutePlan.description: The bounds the trace stage ran under.

strategy.description: The probe for hosts no scan observation covered; absent when those hosts were not traced.

reuse.description: Present when path reuse was enabled for this operation.

shuffle_seed.description: The seed the listed endpoint order was shuffled from; absent for the selected order.
The seed the listed endpoint order was shuffled from; absent for the selected order.

tcpWindow.description: The advertised window of the correlated TCP response, as observed; a window-scan inference input, never an authenticated identity.
